name: Android Development
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y wget unzip && mkdir -p /opt/android/sdk && cd /opt/android/sdk && wget https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-9477386_latest.zip -O cmdline-tools.zip && unzip cmdline-tools.zip && mkdir -p cmdline-tools/latest && mv cmdline-tools/* cmdline-tools/latest/ 2>/dev/null || true && yes | /opt/android/sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=/opt/android/sdk 'platforms;android-34' 'build-tools;34.0.0'
